sentences.en: Algerian police found a stash of weapons on that farm.
sentences.zh: 阿尔及利亚警察在那块农场发现了武器藏匿点。

sentences.en: Fadil drove the car to an abandoned house and stashed it.
sentences.zh: 法德尔把车开到一座废弃的房子，并将它藏了起来。

sentences.en: I have a secret stash of guacamole hidden in the fridge.
sentences.zh: 我有一个藏在冰箱里的秘密鳄梨酱储备。
